review_mode: read-only focused measurement/observer/provenance/budget review; report file only

findings_as_observed.title: A28 accepts arbitrary suppression labels instead of allowed raw-state exceptions
findings_as_observed.evidence: check_group with valid trail/marker geometry, agent_in_view=true, visible=false, suppressed=not_founder returns [] (no errors). check_founding_frame does not validate exemption against carried_foods/carried_woods/state.
findings_as_observed.impact: A visible founder without a bundle can avoid an A28 failure through an invalid suppression reason. Current renderer correctness does not prove the checker rejects this failure.
findings_as_observed.handoff: Root delegated gate strengthening and negative test to p0_measure.

findings_as_observed.title: Blind verification hashes originals but not observer image copies
findings_as_observed.evidence: check_blind iterates frozen key sources and validates source.source SHA; source.image is not read. All six currently frozen A27/A28 observer image copies were checked separately and match source.sha256.
findings_as_observed.impact: A later changed observer-facing copy can pass this provenance gate; no mismatch was observed in the current six images.
findings_as_observed.handoff: Root delegated copied-image hash validation and negative test to p0_measure.

evidence.M01: Source now cross-checks visible founder suppression with independent raw load/state/target and entity pose. Negative test rejects not_founder, hidden_agent, unsupported real_load/eat/asleep; positive cases require real load or correct eat state.
evidence.M02: Source now hashes both observer copy and original source. Negative test starts with PASS then changes only observer-copy bytes and requires FAIL.

resolution_updates.limits: Original findings preserved. This verifies the two checker corrections and targeted regression suite, not a new production-render acceptance claim.

verified_properties: A26 compares independent FFI census counts with each of five cumulative tallies, exactly-one feed identity/key/tick, drawn death multisets and per-reason RGB; actual HUD text is checked in addition to numeric getter.
A27 compares raw settlement IDs/parent/member fields with UI rows, view transforms, font9–12, distinct overview colors and selected membership outlines.
A28 verifies source fission ticks, one feed event per departure/founding/cancellation and tally agreement; group leaders/members/site tiles derive from raw Founding fields.
A29 requires raw daughter-only rain targeting, applied toast, simultaneous daughter-ash/original-fire evidence and hash-bound independent review.
A30 requires two300-frame finite positive datasets, matching run/seed/zoom/frozen mode, load records, source manifest and median ratio<=1.15 plus39audit closures.
Blind scores are recomputed against frozen answer bytes and observer byte hashes; two distinct observers and unchanged3/4(A27),2/2(A28) thresholds are required.
Final A11 verifier compares reconstructed crop pixels exactly with frozen4x/2x grids; measure_p7 checks final raw lineup file hashes before accepting the identity result.
compact_previews_p7 modifies only published GIFs, verifies retained decoded pixels and total duration, preserves external raw cycles and writes reduction provenance.
limits: Focused source review, not a comprehensive audit of every inherited A1–A25 implementation.
No production rendering files changed, no windowed sessions or full measurement reruns launched.
No claim that source checks replace independent image observation, final gate, same-load performance run or publication byte-budget measurement.
Findings are retained as observed; later fixes belong in resolution_updates rather than rewriting original verdicts.
